what: First buyers of gold from Kyrgyzstan: partners' recorded imports of HS 7108 from Kyrgyzstan, 2023 and 2024 combined. Used to pass on Kyrgyzstan's hidden gold payments to Russia (uncovered.json hidden_channels) to the buyers, as for other hubs; Kyrgyzstan keeps a 5% margin.

source.name: UN Comtrade public preview API, imports of HS 7108 with partner Kyrgyzstan (417), 2023-2024

caveats: Partners record more gold from Kyrgyzstan than Kyrgyzstan reports exporting; which of these purchases contain Russian gold is unknown, so the shares of all recorded purchases are used. Switzerland and the United Kingdom are refining and trading centres; the gold may have been sold on again.
